registry_policy.weight_policy: Git stores manifests, parameters, metrics, provenance, and SHA-256 checksums. Multi-gigabyte model weights remain in persistent artifact storage.

records.acceptance: 10/10 seeds completed; Eff=0 on all seeds (500/500 direct prompts); held-out Gen=4.0 mean with 40/1000 paraphrase failures; final probes were not used for repair selection or optimization

usage.MCF: For the fair ZeroUnlearn-style comparison on Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct, use mcf-zerounlearn-locked-forget-only-rank2-seeds1-10-20260810. It uses 50 forget records only during Stage 1/2, locks paraphrase/neighborhood probes until final evaluation, and keeps 1000 MCF retain records evaluation-only. Keep the controlled-fivefold record for the separate controlled_fivefold protocol.
usage.TOFU: Use the saved Forget05 seed-42 checkpoint only for the recorded local probability protocol until full tofu_eval is stored separately.
usage.ZsRE: Use one separately trained and repaired selected checkpoint per seed. The registered 10-seed Setting 5e plus active-repair result passed all configured gates for seeds 1 through 10; use its manifest for aggregate metrics, paths, and recreation parameters.
